fact: The Capital Market Authority invited the public to read the draft regulation governing intermediary service platform operators on its website and send comments by email by 24 February 2026.

The Capital Markets Authority and National Bank of Rwanda published the draft law regulating virtual assets business on 6 March 2025 and invited public comments by email to 14 March and at a virtual Zoom consultation on 17 March 2025.
